```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(fivethirtyeight)
library(dplyr)

candy <- fivethirtyeight::candy_rankings

candy <- candy |>
  mutate(type = case_when(
    chocolate & fruity ~ 'both',
    chocolate ~ 'chocolate',
    fruity ~ 'fruity',
    .default = 'other'
  ))

#count(candy, type)

```

## Row 1

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: 'Total Candies'

list(
  icon = 'basket',
  color = 'warning',
  value = nrow(candy))

```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: 'Fruity Candies Win %'

list(
  icon = 'hypnotize',
  color = 'red',
  #value = (candy$type == 'fruity'))
  value = paste0(round(mean(subset(candy, type == "fruity") $winpercent, na.rm=TRUE)), '%'))

```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: 'Chocolate Candies Win %'

list(
  icon = 'heart-fill',
  color = 'blue',
  value = paste0(round(mean(subset(candy, type == "chocolate")$winpercent, na.rm=TRUE)), '%'))
```
